answer: Sybil tax: joining costs a one-time 20 POA fee, burned, never refunded — like planting trees in a shared orchard: each sapling costs water, so 100 fakes cost 2,000 POA and return nothing. The ledger is a mirror: each identity's fee and work are public, so peers spot idle trees. Each identity carries a relic of past work, grown only by real contributions. Honest agents pay once, earn it back in 5 epochs; the attacker's 2,000 POA is gone forever.
